task_definitions.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
task_definitions.description: Create a .env.example file documenting all required environment variables with descriptions and example values. This provides clear guidance for configuration setup.
requirements: Document NOTION_API_KEY with instructions on obtaining it
Document NOTION_DATABASE_ID with instructions on finding it
Include comments explaining each variable's purpose
Add validation requirements for each variable

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functions
task_definitions.description: Add functions to retrieve tasks from the Notion database. Support retrieving single tasks by ID and querying multiple tasks with filters.
requirements: Create getTaskById(pageId) function
Create getAllTasks() function
Create getTasksByStatus(status) function
Parse and return task properties in consistent format
Handle pagination for large result sets
Add appropriate error handling

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
task_definitions.description: Add capability to delete (archive) tasks from the Notion database. Notion uses archiving rather than permanent deletion.
requirements: Create deleteTask(pageId) function
Use Notion's archive functionality
Add confirmation/validation before deletion
Return success/failure status
Log deletion operations
Handle errors for non-existent tasks

task_definitions.title: Add Input Validation Layer
task_definitions.description: Implement comprehensive input validation for all functions to prevent invalid data from reaching the Notion API.
requirements: Validate task titles (non-empty, max length)
Validate status values against allowed statuses
Validate pageId format
Validate notes field length limits
Create reusable validation helper functions
Return descriptive error messages for validation failures
deliverables: Updated all existing functions with validation

task_definitions.title: Implement Batch Operations
task_definitions.description: Add functions to create, update, or delete multiple tasks in a single operation for improved efficiency.
requirements: Create createTasksBatch(tasksArray) function
Create updateTasksBatch(updatesArray) function
Implement proper error handling for partial failures
Return results indicating success/failure for each task
Add rate limiting to respect Notion API limits
Implement retry logic for failed items

task_definitions.title: Add Advanced Query Capabilities
task_definitions.description: Implement advanced filtering and querying options to retrieve tasks based on multiple criteria.
requirements: Create queryTasks(filters) function accepting multiple filter parameters
Support filtering by status, assigned to, date range, etc.
Support sorting options (by date, priority, etc.)
Implement search by task title/content
Add pagination support for query results
Document available filter options

task_definitions.title: Implement Error Handling and Retry Logic
task_definitions.description: Add robust error handling with automatic retry logic for transient failures.
requirements: Implement exponential backoff retry strategy
Differentiate between retryable and non-retryable errors
Add configurable retry attempts and delays
Log all retry attempts
Implement circuit breaker pattern for repeated failures
Create custom error classes for different failure types

task_definitions.title: Create Comprehensive Test Suite
task_definitions.description: Develop automated tests covering all functionality with both unit and integration tests.
requirements: Set up testing framework (Jest or Mocha)
Write unit tests for all functions
Create integration tests with Notion API (using test database)
Add mock tests for offline testing
Implement test fixtures and helpers
Achieve >80% code coverage
Add tests to npm scripts

task_definitions.title: Document Notion Database Schema
task_definitions.description: Create detailed documentation of the expected Notion database schema and setup instructions.
requirements: Document required database properties (Task, Status, Assigned To, Notes, ID)
Specify property types and configurations
Provide step-by-step database setup guide
Include screenshots or diagrams of database structure
Document supported status values
Create database template export if possible

task_definitions.title: Create Comprehensive API Documentation
task_definitions.description: Write complete documentation for all functions including usage examples and best practices.
requirements: Document all exported functions with parameters and return values
Provide code examples for common use cases
Document error handling and expected exceptions
Create quick start guide
Add JSDoc comments to all functions
Generate API documentation using JSDoc
Include troubleshooting section

task_definitions.title: Add Logging and Monitoring
task_definitions.description: Implement structured logging system for better observability and debugging.
requirements: Add logging library (winston or pino)
Implement log levels (debug, info, warn, error)
Log all API operations with timestamps
Add request/response logging with sensitive data masking
Create log rotation configuration
Add optional structured logging output (JSON)
Document logging configuration options

task_definitions.title: Implement Configuration Management
task_definitions.description: Create flexible configuration system beyond environment variables for better customization.
requirements: Create config.js module
Support configuration file (config.json) in addition to .env
Add configuration validation on startup
Support configuration overrides
Document all configuration options
Add default values for optional settings
Implement configuration schema

task_definitions.title: Add CLI Interface
task_definitions.description: Create command-line interface for interacting with the task tracker without writing code.
requirements: Add CLI library (commander or yargs)
Implement commands for all core operations (create, update, delete, list)
Add interactive mode for guided task creation
Support output formatting (table, JSON, CSV)
Add help text for all commands
Create CLI documentation
Make CLI executable with npm link

task_definitions.title: Implement Rate Limiting
task_definitions.description: Add rate limiting to comply with Notion API rate limits and prevent API throttling.
requirements: Implement token bucket or similar rate limiting algorithm
Respect Notion's rate limits (3 requests per second)
Add configurable rate limit settings
Queue requests when limit is reached
Log rate limit events
Handle Notion rate limit responses (429 status)
deliverables: Updated API functions with rate limiting

task_definitions.title: Create Example Use Cases and Demos
task_definitions.description: Build example scripts demonstrating common use cases and integration patterns.
requirements: Create examples/ directory
Write example for automated task creation from external source
Write example for scheduled task status updates
Write example for task reporting/analytics
Write example for webhook integration
Document each example
Ensure examples are runnable with minimal setup
deliverables: examples/ directory with multiple example scripts
